note: Per-package coverage floors; they only rise between re-seeds. Procedures (go-production-grade Phase 0c): a package split or rename re-seeds the affected entries at their measured post-change values in the same commit, with the rationale in that commit's message; composition changes (code added to or deleted from a package) re-baseline the same way. These floors are darwin measurements; linux floors live in coverage-ratchet-linux.json, seeded at production-grade Phase 1 by the two-pass bootstrap (pass one: full gate with METASYSTEM_COVERAGE_RATCHET_SEED=1, floors written from that run; pass two: the enforcing gate as the acceptance run). The cmd exemption's reason is recorded in exempt.
